title: Couple Outside Mid-Century Home, Vintage 1958 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from June 1958 depicting a couple standing outside a mid-century modern residence or courtyard building marked with the address number 960. Low masonry walls draped with foliage flank the entrance, topped with decorative lanterns. The photo reflects 1950s suburban architecture and leisure culture in post-war America.
